# Blogger
> Google’s blogging platform for creating, publishing, and managing customizable blogs on the web.

Blogger helps individuals and publishers create blogs, write posts, manage layouts, moderate comments, and publish content using Google accounts. The platform also provides help resources, policy information, developer APIs, and account management tools.

## Core Platform
- [Blogger Home](https://www.blogger.com/): Main landing page for creating and publishing blogs with Blogger.
- [Create Your Blog](https://www.blogger.com/about/): Overview of Blogger features, publishing workflow, and customization options.
- [Sign In](https://www.blogger.com/go/signin): Access Blogger dashboards and blog management tools with a Google account.
- [Blog Dashboard](https://www.blogger.com/home): Central interface for managing blogs, posts, comments, and settings.
- [Profile](https://www.blogger.com/profile-find.g): Entry point for Blogger profile discovery and account-related profile features.

## Help Center
- [Blogger Help Center](https://support.google.com/blogger/): Official support hub for using Blogger and troubleshooting common issues.
- [Get Started with Blogger](https://support.google.com/blogger/topic/3339243): Introductory help articles for creating and setting up a blog.
- [Manage Your Blog](https://support.google.com/blogger/topic/12433): Help resources for posts, pages, comments, and blog administration.
- [Customize Your Blog](https://support.google.com/blogger/topic/6321969): Guides for themes, layouts, gadgets, and appearance settings.
- [Fix a Problem](https://support.google.com/blogger/topic/44410): Troubleshooting articles for login, publishing, and blog access issues.
- [Policies and Abuse](https://support.google.com/blogger/topic/3339382): Support content for reporting abuse and understanding enforcement actions.

## Publishing and Content Management
- [Create a Post](https://support.google.com/blogger/answer/1623800): Instructions for writing, formatting, and publishing blog posts.
- [Create a Page](https://support.google.com/blogger/answer/165955): Guide to adding standalone pages to a Blogger site.
- [Manage Comments](https://support.google.com/blogger/answer/187141): Help for moderating, enabling, and configuring blog comments.
- [Schedule Posts](https://support.google.com/blogger/answer/41373): Instructions for setting future publication dates on posts.
- [Use Labels](https://support.google.com/blogger/answer/42320): Organize posts with labels to improve navigation and discovery.
- [Save and Manage Drafts](https://support.google.com/blogger/answer/1623800): Draft workflow details for editing content before publication.

## Design and Customization
- [Change Your Blog Template](https://support.google.com/blogger/answer/46888): Help for selecting and applying Blogger themes and templates.
- [Edit Layouts](https://support.google.com/blogger/answer/43708): Manage page structure, gadgets, and layout components.
- [Add Gadgets](https://support.google.com/blogger/answer/41095): Instructions for inserting widgets and sidebar elements.
- [Use Custom Domains](https://support.google.com/blogger/answer/1233387): Configure a custom domain name for a Blogger blog.
- [Edit HTML](https://support.google.com/blogger/answer/46870): Guidance for modifying theme HTML and advanced template settings.

## Account, Settings, and Administration
- [Basic Settings](https://support.google.com/blogger/answer/41387): Configure blog title, privacy, publishing, and permissions settings.
- [Authors and Admins](https://support.google.com/blogger/answer/42673): Manage blog contributors, authors, and administrator access.
- [Import or Back Up a Blog](https://support.google.com/blogger/answer/41387): Access settings related to exporting and importing blog content.
- [Delete a Blog](https://support.google.com/blogger/answer/41387): Information on removing a blog from your Blogger account.
- [Language and Formatting](https://support.google.com/blogger/answer/97933): Set locale, date formats, and language preferences for a blog.

## Developer and API
- [Blogger API Overview](https://developers.google.com/blogger): Official developer entry point for Blogger API resources.
- [Blogger API Reference](https://developers.google.com/blogger/docs/3.0/reference): REST resource reference for blogs, posts, pages, and comments.
- [Using the Blogger API](https://developers.google.com/blogger/docs/3.0/using): Guide to authenticating and making Blogger API requests.
- [Java Client Library](https://developers.google.com/resources/api-libraries/documentation/blogger/v3/java/latest/): Generated Java client documentation for Blogger API v3.
- [API Libraries](https://developers.google.com/blogger/docs/3.0/api-lib): Supported client libraries and integration resources for Blogger API access.

## Policies and Legal
- [Content Policy](https://blogger.com/go/contentpolicy): Blogger rules governing acceptable published content and platform use.
- [Terms of Service](https://www.google.com/policies/terms/): Google terms applicable to Blogger and related services.
- [Privacy Policy](https://policies.google.com/privacy): Google privacy policy covering account and service data practices.
- [Community Guidelines Help](https://support.google.com/blogger/answer/3339241): Help information related to Blogger community and content standards.
- [Report Abuse](https://support.google.com/blogger/answer/42595): Official process for reporting policy violations and abusive blogs.

## Google Account and Ecosystem
- [Google Account](https://myaccount.google.com/): Manage the Google account used for Blogger access and settings.
- [Google Accounts Help](https://support.google.com/accounts/): Support for sign-in, security, and account recovery issues.
- [Google Workspace Updates](https://workspaceupdates.googleblog.com/): Product update blog that may include relevant Google platform changes.
- [Google Developers](https://developers.google.com/): Broader Google developer documentation ecosystem connected to Blogger APIs.
